Container.Name: Homelabarr - Socket Proxy
Container.Overview: Docker socket proxy preset for Homelabarr. The Homelabarr Backend reaches Docker only through this proxy, which allows listing, starting, stopping and restarting containers and reading their logs, and refuses exec, build and the other dangerous endpoints. Install it before the Backend.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: home lab docker containers management gui web interface deploy
Container.Requires: Install all three Homelabarr templates: Socket Proxy, Backend and Frontend. Create their network once from the Unraid terminal: docker network create homelabarr
